title: GHZ State
subtitle: Build the 3-qubit Greenberger–Horne–Zeilinger state
description: Construct a circuit that produces the GHZ state (|000⟩ + |111⟩)/√2 on 3 qubits. This is the multi-qubit generalization of the Bell state — all three qubits are maximally entangled.
hint: Start like a Bell state, then extend the entanglement chain to the third qubit.
objectives: Extend Bell state preparation to 3+ qubits
Understand GHZ states and multi-party entanglement
